description: One row scored by a model in use. Never a value of the row: its key is a salted hash.

at.description: When it was scored: ISO 8601 with its zone (UTC).
at.title: At

batch.description: The request the row came in (rows of a batch were scored together).
batch.title: Batch

decision.description: The action taken, as a code (alert, no_alert); None when the service decides nothing.
decision.title: Decision

key.description: The row's key as a salted hash (key_hash), never the caller's value.
key.title: Key

model_version.description: Which fit of it: a fingerprint of the model file.
model_version.title: Model Version

position.description: The row's place in its batch.
position.title: Position

predicted_class.description: Multiclass: the chosen class, by its index in the model's class labels.
predicted_class.title: Predicted Class

score.description: Binary: the score; multiclass: the chosen class's probability; regression: the prediction.
score.title: Score

threshold.description: The threshold the decision used, when it used one.
threshold.title: Threshold

title: PredictionRecord
